client_id_note: Declared unused: not assigned to any other adapter, session or probe in this repo. Must be verified free (no 'client id already in use' TWS API error 326) before reuse.
data_mode_note: Predeclared expectation: this paper account is not assumed to hold a live US equity market-data subscription. If the gateway grants REALTIME, the probe records REALTIME as observed; DELAYED is never upgraded to REALTIME in the receipt regardless of declared expectation. A quote reported as DELAYED never satisfies a case that later requires a current real-time feed.

rc5_surface_used.handshake_and_account_query: Hand-rolled minimal read-only TWS API v100+ socket protocol (handshake, REQ_START_API, REQ_MANAGED_ACCTS, REQ_POSITIONS, REQ_ALL_OPEN_ORDERS, REQ_ACCOUNT_SUMMARY). No order-related outgoing message (PLACE_ORDER, CANCEL_ORDER, EXERCISE_OPTIONS, REQ_GLOBAL_CANCEL) is ever constructed or sent by probe.py.
rc5_surface_used.contract_identity_and_bars: nautilus_trader.adapters.interactive_brokers.HistoricalInteractiveBrokersClient + InteractiveBrokersInstrumentProvider (installed 2.0.0rc5), the officially bundled Rust-backed read-only surface for instrument/historical-bar retrieval.
rc5_surface_used.rationale: rc5's Python-exposed IB surface (see __init__.pyi) has no standalone class for account summary, positions or open orders outside a full TradingNode (msgbus/cache/clock) wiring, which is out of scope for this bounded step-1 probe; those items use the documented, stable, decades-old TWS API wire messages instead. Contract identity and historical bars use the rc5-bundled client directly rather than hand-rolled contract encoding, which is more version-fragile.

notes: Step 1 of blueprints/us-equities/engine-nautilus/acceptance-plan.md section 5. Execution is disabled throughout: no order submission path is constructed or reachable from probe.py.
